S24.answer: The main risks of buying off-plan in Dubai are **delivery uncertainty**—the completion date or specifications may change—and **developer or project risk**, including delays or, in more serious cases, failure to complete. You also commit before you can inspect the finished home, and the resale market or value at handover may differ from your expectations. Before committing, review the sale contract, payment milestones, permitted changes and cancellation terms, and independently verify the project’s registration and the developer’s track record.
